name: Stitch & Thread of the World
subtitle: Bargello, Blackwork & more
shortDescription: 7 European embroidery and thread-work traditions to play: Bargello, Matyó embroidery, Filet lace and Federkielstickerei.
longDescription:
Stitch & Thread of the World: 7 European embroidery and thread-work traditions from 6 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Bargello, Matyó embroidery, Filet lace, Federkielstickerei, Assisi embroidery, Blackwork and Broderie anglaise.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can count threads, choose silks, wools and cottons and stitch each traditional pattern onto the cloth, from long wool flames to quill, lace and white-on-white work, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
